---
name: 删除 / 修改请求（Takedown request）
about: 权利人或任何认为内容不当的人，请用此模板要求删除或修改内容。Rights holders or anyone who believes content here is inappropriate may request removal or revision.
title: "[takedown] "
labels: takedown
assignees: ''
---

<!-- 请不要在公开 Issue 中填写身份证件、电话等敏感个人信息。Please do not post sensitive personal information in a public issue. -->

## 1. 涉及的内容 / Content concerned

- 文件路径与位置（例如 `concepts/02-business-quality.md` 第 7 条）/ File path and location:
- 涉及的文字或引文（简述即可）/ The text or quotation concerned (a short description is enough):

## 2. 请求类型 / Request type

- [ ] 删除 / Remove
- [ ] 修改 / Revise
- [ ] 删除链接 / Remove a link
- [ ] 其他 / Other:

## 3. 理由 / Reason

- [ ] 我是权利人或其授权代表 / I am the rights holder or an authorized representative
- [ ] 内容有误或不当 / The content is inaccurate or inappropriate
- 说明 / Details:

## 4. 确认 / Confirmation

- [ ] 我已确认上述信息在我所知范围内真实准确 / The information above is accurate to the best of my knowledge

---

维护者会在核实后尽快删除或修改相关内容，并在本 Issue 中回复处理结果。
The maintainer will review and remove or revise the content promptly, and reply in this issue.
